Name: Cute Valley Ridgeside
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
I'm a huge fan of [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie[/url]'s Cute Valley retexture mod of the farm, as well as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] mod. After awhile of playing, I realized that I wanted the Ridgeside farmhouse to match the Cute Valley vibe, so- I made this mod! It's a recolor and retexture of the Ridgeside farmhouse to match the Cute Valley aesthetic. It comes in blue, pink, and purple, to match the varying colors available for Cute Valley! If you'd like your Ridgeside farmhouse to match the Cute Valley vibe, just choose your color, download, and install!


[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1.[/b] Make sure that you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2.[/b] Download the Cute Valley Ridgeside color of your choice, blue, pink, or purple.
[b]3.[/b] Unzip the '[CP] Cute Valley Ridgeside' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]4.[/b] Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new farmhouse!


[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Credit to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided inspiration for this retexture!
[*]Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]﻿, the creator behind [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ and the original Ridgeside farmhouse texture!
[/list]
